Summary of Active Parameters and Their Optimized Values

The table below lists the 258 rate parameters that remain active after freezing the unconstrainted ones. In the table, the rate parameters are ranked in the order from C0 to C4,

  • No.: the first column indicates the index of each active parameter, ranging from 1 to 258.
  • Reaction No.: the second column lists the index of reaction in FFCM-2, ranging from 1 to 1054.
  • Reaction: the reaction pathway of each rate parameter.
  • Type: the type of rate parameter, either an A-factor (A) or a three-body Chaperon efficiency (M).
  • $x_{i}^*$: the value of the optimized normalized rate parameter.
  • Multiplier: the optimized value for the multiplier of the A factor \(A_i^*/A_{i,0}\) or three-body efficiency \(M_i^*/M_{i,0}\).
  • $f_{i, trial}$: the uncertainty factor assigned to each reaction rate coefficient in the trial model.
  • $f^{*}_{i, opt}$: the uncertainty factor of the optimized rate coefficient.
